references.text: The previous campsite in the travel route - Rimmon-Perez is mentioned as the place they departed from
The next campsite in the travel route - from Libnah they continued to Rissah
Libnah is mentioned as a Canaanite city that Joshua conquered during the entry into the land
Libnah was given to the priests as a Levitical city in the tribe of Judah
Libnah revolted against Judah during the time of King Joram
Libnah was one of the cities besieged by the Assyrian king Sennacherib
